answerPs: واکسین بدن ته زده کوي چې د ځینو خطرناکو ناروغیو لکه شري، پولیو، نري رنځ او ټیټانوس پر وړاندې مبارزه وکړي. واکسین شوي ماشومان لږ ناروغه کیږي. واکسین هم ماشوم ساتي او هم ټولنه.
answerEn: Vaccines teach the body to fight dangerous diseases such as measles, polio, tuberculosis, and tetanus. Vaccinated children get sick less often. Vaccines protect both the child and the community.

answerEn: At birth or soon after, babies usually receive first vaccines such as BCG (tuberculosis), polio, and hepatitis B. Other vaccines follow at set months. Get the schedule and card from your clinic.

answerEn: Do not worry — usually you do not need to start over. Take the child to the clinic as soon as you can and bring the vaccination card. The health worker will give the missed doses.

questionPs: له واکسین وروسته تبه یا درد عادي دی؟

answerPs: هو، لږه تبه، د پیچکارۍ پر ځای درد یا سوروالی، او لږه ژړا عادي دي او معمولاً په یوه یا دوو ورځو کې ښه کیږي. ماشوم ته شیدې او مایعات ورکړئ. که لوړه تبه، تشنج، د ساه ستونزه یا د مخ پړسوب پیدا شي، سمدستي کلینیک ته ولاړ شئ.
answerEn: Yes — mild fever, pain or redness at the injection site, and a little crying are common and usually improve in one or two days. Give milk and fluids. For high fever, seizure, breathing trouble, or facial swelling, go to a clinic immediately.

answerEn: Yes. Vaccines are tested carefully before use and given to millions of children worldwide. Serious side effects are very rare. The risk from the disease is much greater than the risk from the vaccine.

answerEn: Measles is highly contagious and can cause pneumonia, diarrhea, blindness, or death. Signs include fever, cough, red eyes, and a red body rash. Both measles vaccine doses protect the child. Take a child with these signs to a clinic.

questionPs: پولیو قطرې ولې څو ځله ورکول کیږي؟
questionEn: Why are polio drops given several times?
answerPs: پولیو کولی شي د ماشوم لاسونه او پښې د تل لپاره شل کړي او درملنه نه لري؛ یوازې واکسین یې مخه نیسي. د بشپړ خوندیتوب لپاره ماشوم ته څو ځله پولیو قطرې اړینې دي، نو ماشوم هر کمپاین او د کلینیک هر نوبت ته ورسوئ.
answerEn: Polio can permanently paralyse a child’s arms or legs and has no cure — only vaccine prevents it. Several rounds of polio drops are needed for full protection, so bring the child to every campaign and clinic appointment.
